description: Source code for the Customer doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for customer management, validation, and related utility functions.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: ERPNext Customer doctype class with methods for customer management, validation, and related operations.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns the customer name for activity feeds.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads address, contact, and dashboard info when customer document is loaded.

methods.name: load_dashboard_info
methods.description: Fetches and sets dashboard info for the customer.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Automatically sets the customer name based on configuration.

methods.name: get_customer_name
methods.description: Generates a unique customer name if a duplicate exists.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Updates lead status after customer creation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on customer data.

methods.name: get_customer_group_details
methods.description: Fetches details of the customer group and updates customer accordingly.

methods.name: check_customer_group_change
methods.description: Checks if the customer group has changed.

methods.name: validate_default_bank_account
methods.description: Validates if the default bank account is a company account.

methods.name: validate_internal_customer
methods.description: Ensures only one internal customer per company.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Performs actions after customer document is updated.

methods.name: update_customer_groups
methods.description: Updates linked documents when customer group changes.

methods.name: create_primary_contact
methods.description: Creates primary contact if not set.

methods.name: create_primary_address
methods.description: Creates primary address if not set.

methods.name: update_lead_status
methods.description: Marks lead as converted when customer is created from lead.

methods.name: create_lead_address_contact
methods.description: Creates address and contact from lead details.

methods.name: validate_name_with_customer_group
methods.description: Ensures customer name does not conflict with existing customer group.

methods.name: validate_credit_limit_on_change
methods.description: Validates credit limit changes against outstanding amounts.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Cleans up contacts and lead status when customer is deleted.

methods.name: after_rename
methods.description: Updates customer name after renaming.

methods.name: set_loyalty_program
methods.description: Assigns a loyalty program to the customer.

methods.name: create_onboarding_docs
methods.description: Creates onboarding documents for multiple customers.
